name: adr-review
tagline_zh: 写好的 ADR 自己看不出漏洞？让没参与的新同事视角帮你挑叙事和结构毛病，顺手重写。像请了个只读你文档的挑剔队友。
tagline_en: Your ADRs have blind spots? Get a fresh-eyes teammate to spot narrative & structure flaws, then rewrite. Like a.
desc_en: Review one or more ADRs with fresh eyes (as a team member without prior context), identify narrative and structural issues, then rewrite them. Use when the user asks to review, improve, rewrite, or take a fresh-eyes pass on an ADR or a set of ADRs (Architecture Decision Records).
why_zh: 它模拟无背景团队成员，专挑逻辑断点和结构松散，而非泛泛语法检查，改完直接可用。
why_en: Simulates a no-context teammate, targeting logical gaps and structural looseness, not grammar—output is rewrite-ready.
